required_conditional_inputs: Fresh selected B1 cursor; one DATA source leaf; empty dependency/leaf-resource closure; captured/current root components identical; no additional producer or unmodeled concurrent registry/owner mutation before ready. The designated old reader remains idle.

LookupNodes bounds all actual table links and terminal sentinel for the relevant calls. RegistryCapacity bounds probe-array capacity, not merely live entries, including constructor/observation growth.

Owner Add, removal, queue, Observe/Unobserve, Write, Arena and Primary child inputs must independently dominate their actual entry-to-next-persisted-progress units, including binding visits and rollback. A Complete flag is an assertion of these prerequisites, not independent proof.

VisibleCapacity, DebtCapacity and SealsCapacity bound both reachable old backing and its charged full capacity; counts and capacities must come from the supported pre-cursor census and its separately proved transformation, with no intervening unsupported growth.

Namespace/file/path/logical-lane/platform lengths bound the actual strings, including duplicated-file suffixes. DB IndexFileBytes means full file.Name length. Snapshot producer arity must bound actual callback operands; interpreting it only as deduplicated owners requires a separate equality proof (the selected two producer owners are distinct).

Selected borrowed PRIMARY certificate already exists; selected empty manifest has zero dependency edges. Nonempty folds/groups/manifest edges and lazy certificate birth are outside the four-target envelope.

Snapshot postbirth enrollment, caching caller/cursor ancestors, transaction birth, terminal cancellation/error paths and actual caller tails must be separately composed. Stable capture successful phase-seven operation/namespace releases are nonlast because the token owns the matching edges.
